# Extended Data 2

```{r latexmk}
#| cache: false
file_latex_src <- "extended-data-02-workflow-image-analysis.tex"
## Ignore any build failures if the LaTeX environemnt is not setup.  The
## environment either requires an existing LaTeX system installation that we
## treat as an optional requirement or sizeable files installed into the home
## directory that a typical end user may not want.
try(
  tinytex::latexmk(
    file = file_latex_src,
    engine = "lualatex",
    install_packages = FALSE))
```

```{r latex-log}

## Show the full LaTeX log for troubleshooting if there was any build error.

}
```
